description: Label and value pairs, such as specs, order details or contact data.

howToUse: Use `layout="rows"` for a short list in a narrow column, with the value aligned to the right.
Use `layout="columns"` for specs read at a glance; the grid fills the width with pairs of at least 150px.
Put conditions in `hint` ("per month", "includes shipping") instead of crowding the value.
`title` heads the list, such as "Order #48213", and names it for screen readers.
alternatives: Many rows with sorting or filters: Table.
One number in the spotlight: Stat.

keyboard.action: The list does not receive focus. Screen readers announce each value with its label.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
